nuance: A Project's colour is changeable after creation, not fixed at creation time

todoist.createSurface: INLINE editor at the foot of the project tree on /app/projects/active — a 'Project color' combobox plus a tiptap/ProseMirror contenteditable div[aria-label='Project name'], with 'Add project' and 'Close add project editor' buttons. NOT a modal dialog — unlike Todoist's own label create, which is.
todoist.editSurface: Project options menu -> Edit -> modal role=dialog
todoist.colourChangeMethod: Edit dialog -> Color combobox -> role=listbox -> option 'Teal' -> Save
todoist.persistenceCheck: Edit dialog reopened from the project options menu after saving; the combobox read 'Teal'.

meologue.createSurface: inline form on /todo/projects — select[aria-label="New Project's colour"] plus input[aria-label="New Project's name"] and an Add button
meologue.editSurface: the project's own route /todo/projects/:projectId — everything inline, no dialog: select[aria-label='Project colour'], input[aria-label='Project name'], Favourite, Archive, an activity link, and the Delete button
meologue.persistenceCheck: SPA-navigated to /todo/today and back to the project; the select still read 'teal' (#148FAD).

verdict.nuanceItself: MATCH — the colour is changeable after creation in both apps, and the change persists in both.
verdict.palette: MATCH, and a strong one: 20 colours for 20, identical names in identical order. Only the casing differs (Todoist title-cases, meologue lowercases).
verdict.surface: DIVERGENT — Todoist recolours through a modal Edit dialog reached from an options menu; meologue recolours from a select sitting on the project's own page. Todoist also carries a name counter (8/120), a Description, a Parent project, an Access level and a Layout choice in that dialog; meologue has a Description field but no counter, no parent, no access, no layout.
verdict.reason: The nuance's own claim is satisfied on both sides; the row is divergent only in how the change is reached, which is recorded rather than treated as a defect.
